changelog:
RS Optimization v1.14.0 — FiveM Expert Tools + Remember Me
• Frame Pacing Optimizer: measured trial FPS cap advice; apply manually in GPU software.
• Overlay Conflict Detector: running overlay/capture app scan with review guidance.
• Shader Cache Health: cache size, file counts, access and free-space checks; no automatic deletion.
• Server Comparison Mode: route-matched sessions grouped by server, profile and phase.
• Crash Pattern Detector: repeated FiveM/GTA Windows crash/hang signatures from the last 7 days.
• Network Jitter Test: 20 cancellable ICMP probes with RTT, jitter and missing-reply results.
• Remember me: encrypted session token, online validation, logout removal; password never saved.
Find the tools in FiveM Hub → 04 / Expert Tools. All previous modules included.
Validation: 40 checks passed; no guaranteed FPS gain.
Detailed changelog: https://github.com/NutzuSefu/rs-config/releases/tag/v1.14.0
